run_plain_text_csv: run the script with tool_num 1 to convert plain text lines into CSV format for Turk annotation
run_highlighted_text_csv: run the script with tool_num 2 to generate CSV with highlighted words, intent, and child fields
run_reference_object_csv: run the script with tool_num 3 to generate CSV for reference object annotation with highlighted spans
run_comparison_filters_csv: run the script with tool_num 4 to generate CSV for comparison-based filter annotation tasks
run_qualification_test_csv: run the script with tool_num 5 to generate a qualification test CSV with three commands per row
